articles.title: Discord Users’ Data Exposed in Security Bot Double Counter Security Breach
articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Hijack .gh, .sl and .as Registry to Obtain Unauthorized HTTPS Certificates
articles.summary:
Hackers compromised the .gh, .sl and .as country-code domain registries and used their access to obtain unauthorized HTTPS certificates for Google and other organizations. Chrome blocked the identified certificates automatically, while Google worked with certificate authorities to revoke those covering its properties. articles.title: CrowdStrike, AWS, and NVIDIA Expand Global Cybersecurity Startup Accelerator
articles.summary:

The global initiative will help early-stage companies develop agentic cybersecurity products through technical mentorship, business development, and broader access to enterprise security ecosystems. articles.title: SonicWall Patches 4 SMA1000 Flaws, Including Critical Pre-Auth SSRF Rated CVSS 10
articles.summary:
SonicWall has patched four vulnerabilities in its Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 Series appliances, including a critical server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw with a maximum CVSS score of 10.0. The bug could let a remote attacker without valid credentials make the appliance send requests on their behalf, reach internal functions, and perform unauthorized operations. The […]

articles.title: Hackers Breach Two Major South Korean Churches, Exposing Data of Over 1 Million People
articles.summary:
Hackers breached two major South Korean churches, exposing more than one million congregant records and extensive financial and administrative data. The investigation reveals how web shells, leaked credentials, and weak access controls opened routes into connected systems. In one case, attackers entered through a web shell planted in an enterprise resource planning, or ERP, system. […]

articles.title: PoC Exploit Released for Critical Atlassian Flaw That Can Lead to Jira Admin Access
articles.summary:
A proof-of-concept exploit has been released for CVE-2026-21589, a critical arbitrary file-read vulnerability affecting multiple self-managed Atlassian products. The flaw can expose sensitive application files and, in environments integrated with Atlassian Crowd, potentially allow attackers to obtain Jira administrator access. Atlassian issued an out-of-band advisory on October 5. The vulnerability affects numerous Data Center products, […]

articles.title: FBI Warns FortiBleed Attack Compromised 80,000+ Devices and Locked Out Admins
articles.summary:
The FBI and U.S. Secret Service have issued a joint cybersecurity advisory warning that the ongoing FortiBleed campaign is targeting internet-facing Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways worldwide.
